summary: Add an opt-in load test that runs the daemon beside a CPU and disk hog at seat priority and reports the request-latency targets with and without it.

replay.detail: Performance test addition only; no projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No schema, migration or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: No writer, checkpoint, retention or authority changes.

compatibility.detail: The existing load test, its workload, reports and baselines are unchanged; the hog test is opt-in.

downtime.detail: No service or runner deployment is introduced.

manual.detail: No manual step or workflow rerun is introduced.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the opt-in hog test and its stage; nothing stored changes.
